name: PMFBY Grievance API Attributes
privacy_notes: applicantPhone is personal data. It travels inbound only and is never echoed in a response. Nothing proves the caller holds the number: PMFBY's grievance service asks for no OTP, so this is a contact number the portal files on the ticket, not a verified one.

This pack carries no challenge. PMFBY's grievance service issues none, so neither the challenge nor the challengeIssued band exists here and the schema refuses both outright -- a payload carrying either is rejected rather than quietly ignored. The consequence is that filing is unauthenticated: anyone holding an application number can lodge a grievance against it. That is the portal's posture, not one this network introduces.

enrolmentId is the crop insurance application number and identifies a named farmer's policy. It is no-log and no-trace, and never appears in an error body. On support it is Support.orderId, which on_support echoes back to the caller who sent it.
grievance.description is free text written by a farmer and may contain personal details the schema cannot constrain. It is returned verbatim on a case read.

The portal's case record carries far more about the farmer than this pack surfaces -- name, mobile number, email, and the full state / district / sub-district / panchayat / village hierarchy, alongside the insurance policy number and insurer. The adapter must drop all of it and map only the fields named here; none of it may reach commitmentAttributes, a log, or a trace.
